clauses.evidence: [stimulus: this creature attacks alone, unblocked]: 'you gains 4 life (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)', you 20 -> 24, opp 20 -> 16; [attacks and opp_giant blocks it]: 'you gains 4 life', you 20 -> 24. Tree keywords[0] LIFELINK.

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'ask may [fire, skip]', 'ask sacrifice: [you_bear, you_giant]' (only your other creatures, not the Cavalier nor opp creatures), then 'ask target: [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' after the sacrifice (the reflexive trigger chooses its target as it goes on the stack), the target is destroyed. [cast | ask 1 -> skip]: no sacrifice, no destroy, no reflexive trigger. Variants cover both sacrificed creatures and all four targets. Tree: OptionalEffect(SACRIFICE) then Conditional(MAY_DONE, DelayedTrigger(DESTROY target creature CONTROLLER_IS OPPONENT)). F03_1 (yes, with a pick of fodder and victim) and F03_2 (decline) repeat it with a second candidate on each side.

clauses.clause: When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: this card is dealt lethal damage]: 'card dies', 'you_fallen is targeted', 'you_fallen moves graveyard -> battlefield', but with one candidate there is no target ask and the probe never shows its mana value or a card in the other graveyard, so the 'mana value 3 or less' boundary and 'your graveyard' are not pinned. Tree: CreatureDiesEvent(IS_SOURCE); MOVE_ZONE of a TARGET creature card FNot(QTY_GE 4 MANA_VALUE) in Zone(GRAVEYARD, YOU) to the battlefield. F03_3 (mana value 1/3/4 and an opposing mana value 3 card: pick the 3), F03_6 (pick the 1), F03_4 (only a 4 and the opponent's 3: nothing returns), F03_5 (exactly 3 returns, a non-creature stays).
